title: CONTROL-PLANE-2: the personal companion reads /api/v1 and posts signals to /api/v1/events
body:
**Owner:** Staff (platform)
**Trigger:** INTEGRATION_TOKEN bound on ultrastable-tick (done 2026-11-14) and the companion worker deployable
**Done check:** grep:seed/worker/src/controlplane.js::personal-companion
**Status:** closed

CONTROL-PLANE-1 ships the contract: GET /api/v1/status, /agents, /backlog, /activity, /integrations, POST /api/v1/events (bearer INTEGRATION_TOKEN, idempotent on source+id, lands as an EV-<source>-<id> item for the owning role). This item wires the companion side: the companion binds the same token as a secret, shows the org status in its daily brief, and turns owner requests about Ultrastable into events. Closing probe: an EV-personal-companion-* item exists in D1 ultrastable-org created by the companion, and GET https://ultrastable.io/api/v1/integrations reports events.configured true.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 156.9 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
